title: Sangamon County student enrollment for 2024-25 rises slightly
text:
Sangamon County student enrollment for 2024-25 rises slightly
T. D. Branch
The Illinois State Board of Education reports that Sangamon County schools registered 26,286 students for the 2024-25 school year.
Enrollment increased by 0.2% compared to the prior school year, which had 26,224 students.
Sangamon County ranked 11th among Illinois counties by school enrollment.
Of those students, 45% were male, 13.4% were female, and 41.6% indicated either non-binary status or did not provide their gender.
White students made up 62.3% of Sangamon County’s total enrollment that year.
Glenwood High School had the largest enrollment of any school in the county during the school year, registering 1,446 students.
Statewide, Illinois public schools served just under 1.85 million K-12 students in the 2024-25 school year, a continuation of a gradual enrollment decline stretching back several years. During this same time frame, the number of full-time equivalent teachers in Illinois grew to 137,899, which brought the student-teacher ratio to around 17:1.
The trend toward fewer K-12 students statewide mirrors demographic shifts in Illinois. From the 2017-18 to 2024-25 school years, public school enrollment in the state dropped from approximately 2 million to 1.85 million students. That marks a decrease of about 153,000 students, or 7.6%.
